title: Claude Feature 05: Claude ko aapki baatein yaad rakhna (Memory)
description:
Claude Feature 05 (Claude for Everyone): Memory. Claude aapki baatcheet se chhote topics yaad rakhta hai (kaam, project, pasand). Settings me Your Claude kholkar 'Generate memory from chats' toggle se Pause ya Reset karo. Manage se topics dekho, edit ya delete karo. Ek chat bina memory ke: nayi chat me plus dabake Memory band karo (pehla message bhejne se pehle), ya ghost icon se Incognito chat. Har project ki apni memory. Dhyan rakho: chat delete karne se uski memory nahi mitati, usse alag se delete karna padta hai.

Source (official):
https://support.claude.com/en/articles/11817273-use-claude-s-chat-search-and-memory-to-build-on-previous-context

Unofficial channel, not affiliated with Anthropic.

Note: the Settings and chat screens in this video are our own illustration (not a recording). The official page screenshot is our own capture with the key line highlighted. Names in the examples are made up. Synthetic voice.

Music: "Funkorama" Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com)
